Delicious and convenient
Aug 2026 • Couples
Lovely meal and great service. Had landed in Hanoi that day and checked in to the Movenpick Hotel. After the travel did not feel like wandering the streets for a meal so headed downstairs to O Macanese. Great decision. Shared a couple of dishes with a glass of wine and then desert. Every dish was spot on. Good selection of wines. The service was top class. Staff spoke english so travel weary brains did not need to stumble over our broken Vietnamese. Highly recommend.

Excellent service!
Jun 2026 • Family
My family and I had dinner at O Macanese and thoroughly enjoyed the experience. The restaurant offers a warm, elegant, and welcoming atmosphere, making it a great choice for a family meal or a special occasion.

The food was outstanding, both in presentation and taste. Every dish was beautifully plated and full of flavor, showcasing the quality and care that go into the cooking. The portions and overall dining experience felt well worth the price.

If you're looking to experience authentic Macanese cuisine in a comfortable and refined setting, O Macanese is definitely worth a visit.

A beautiful experience
Jul 2025 • Family
Obviously expensive compared to the small restaurants in town (prices are those of a Parisian brasserie), but the place is beautiful, the kitchen is worked and the staff takes care. The promise of Macau-inspired fusion cuisine is well respected and fulfilled. If you want to change a bit of typical local dishes, without going to the pizzeria or the French restaurant, this restaurant is a pretty good idea!
